title: Etale sections lift over the pair-neighbourhood colimit
statement: Let B be a commutative ring and J an ideal. Let C be the full category of rings under B whose structure map is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and whose canonical quotient map B/J to D/JD is bijective. Assume C is essentially small in the universe of B and filtered. Let c be a colimit cocone of its inclusion into rings under B [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with vertex B to H, and assume B/J to H/JH is bijective. For every etale H-algebra A in the universe of B and every H-algebra map sigma : A to H/JH, there exists an H-algebra map tau : A to H whose reduction modulo JH is sigma.

source.place: Tag 0A02, paragraph verifying condition (2) of Tag 09XI

proof.text: Pass to a small equivalent filtered diagram and its underlying ring colimit. Use the given quotient bijection to identify H/JH with R = B/J. Descend the etale H-algebra A to an etale C-algebra D at a stage C, with A isomorphic to H tensor_C D. Restrict the section modulo JH to D to obtain a C-algebra map s : D to R.

The map s kills JD and induces a section D/JD to R. Base change makes D/JD etale over C/JC = R. Apply idempotent splitting to obtain e with s(e)=1 and localization (D/JD)_e isomorphic to R. Lift e to g in D. Localization D_g is etale over B by composition and localization; its quotient is R since localization commutes with quotients. Thus D_g is a neighbourhood object, and C to D_g is a morphism of the diagram.

The coprojection of D_g to H and the identity of H agree on C, so induce an H-algebra map H tensor_C D to H. Since s(g)=1, s extends to D_g. Any B-algebra map from a neighbourhood object to R factors through its quotient and is uniquely the inverse of its quotient isomorphism. Hence this extension is the reduction of the coprojection. The constructed tensor-product map agrees modulo JH with the original section on D and H, therefore on the tensor product. Transport through the descent isomorphism.
